The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith]] [[Zanisk]] and [[Adacin]] led a '''splinter faction''' of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the years after the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the two Sith fled into hiding, remained hidden even after [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Darth Acina]] ascended to the throne to [[Zakuul–Imperial treaty|negotiate a ceasefire]] with [[Zakuul]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

The pair later reemerged on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] to establish a small splinter faction that set up their operations in a [[Separatist stronghold|former separatist base]] located on the planet. Their idea was to attack those planets that allied with the [[Eternal Alliance]] which had risen to prominence at that point during their [[War against Zakuul|rebellion]] against the Eternal Empire. But their activities led to their base being [[Adacin and Zanisk's uprising|attacked]] and the Sith and, to the surprise of no one, their splinter movement were defeated in the ensuring battle.<ref name="SWTOR" /><ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: Lords Adacin and Zanisk}}</ref>
